My dear [Cobweb](/person/675),
I am staying here with the [Secretary](/person/351) and we both give our parting greetings to one of our oldest original [members](/topic/104). I wonder if you will ever have time to continue the Composer series in the [Barnacle](/periodical/89)- I remember when [Christabel](/person/329) told me how many lives you proposed, I was rather alarmed for the chance of the Barnacle living long enough to contain them all.
If you wish still to see the said Barnacle, please let Christabel know- though what is become of the present one is more than I can say
your affectionate
Mother Goose
